checks.invariant: No hardcoded passwords, API keys, tokens, private keys or bearer credentials in tracked files
checks.result: git grep at 6f01438 for ghp_/github_pat_/gho_/sk-/AKIA/xox*/-----BEGIN/password=/secret=/api_key=/bearer patterns across all tracked files returned no matches. Hits for 'token' are prose about LLM tokens (AGENTS.md, modules/enxuto.md) and a crypto.randomUUID() lock-ownership nonce in scripts/setup-github-cli.js:64-68, not a credential.

checks.invariant: No TODO/FIXME/HACK/XXX comments referencing missing security controls
checks.result: No TODO/FIXME/HACK/XXX markers in code. All case-insensitive 'todo' hits are the Portuguese word 'todo' (every). scripts/validate-plan.js:16 matches literal TBD/TODO placeholders in plan file paths as a validation rule, not a deferred control.

checks.invariant: No debug/dev mode that can be enabled to weaken behavior via environment variable or input
checks.result: No DEBUG/dev flag exists. Environment reads are CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT (hooks/stilo-instructions.js:40), PLUGIN_DATA (output format only, hooks/stilo-runtime.js:9), STILO_HOME (hooks/stilo-state.js:32, scripts/setup-github-cli.js:8) and ProgramFiles (scripts/setup-github-cli.js:44); all are set by the same user principal or trusted host, so no lower-trust principal can toggle them.

checks.invariant: No test/example/seed credentials usable in production
checks.result: No credentials in fixtures. tests/fixtures/harness/project/src/records.js is a deliberately flawed tenant-isolation fixture with dummy records (ids a1/b1); it is not loaded by any hook or product path, only by scripts/evaluate-harness.js against a copy.

checks.invariant: No unprotected /debug,/admin,/health,/metrics,/env,/config HTTP endpoints; CORS, cookie attributes, open redirects and TLS enforcement
checks.result: Not applicable: the product has no HTTP server, listener, cookies, CORS headers or redirect logic. Hooks are short-lived stdin/stdout processes (hooks/claude-codex-hooks.json); no require of http/https/net in hooks or scripts. The only URLs are static documentation links (scripts/setup-github-cli.js:86,89) and manifest metadata, all https.

checks.invariant: No .env, credentials.json, *.pem, *.key or similar secret files checked in; .gitignore covers secrets and local config
checks.result: git ls-files contains no .env*, credentials*, *.pem, *.key, *.p12, *.pfx, id_rsa or .npmrc. .gitignore covers node_modules/, *.log, .worktrees/, .superpowers/ and .stilo/* (except review-*.md) but has no explicit .env/*.pem/*.key patterns; no secrets exist so this is hardening only. .stilo/state.json and .stilo/execution-checkpoint.md are tracked (added in e37d66f/45df052) despite the .gitignore comment saying runtime state is never versioned; they contain only phase/progress notes, no secrets.

checks.invariant: Dependencies pinned and free of known CVEs
checks.result: package.json declares no dependencies/devDependencies; all requires in hooks/ and scripts/ are node: built-ins with literal names (no dynamic require). No lockfile is needed; no third-party dependency tree exists.

No eval(), new Function() or dynamic import() anywhere. Sinks found: child_process.spawn with shell:false in scripts/setup-github-cli.js:16, spawnSync in hooks/stilo-setup.js:4-6, and node:vm runInContext of a copy's src/records.js in scripts/evaluate-harness.js:26-41 with fixed interpolated expressions. These sinks are owned by peer units (hunter-install for spawn/probe path trust, hunter-scripts for vm injection) and were not re-investigated here.

checks.invariant: Error output does not leak stack traces, internal paths or secrets across a trust boundary
checks.result: Errors print only e.message, never stacks. hooks/stilo-state.js:137 carries fs error messages (which include the local absolute path) into the agent context via hooks/stilo-instructions.js:176 after sanitiza truncation; scripts print error.message to the invoking user's stderr. The recipient is the same local user and their own agent session, so no boundary is crossed.

hardening: .gitignore does not include explicit patterns for .env, .env.*, *.pem, *.key or credentials.json; no such files exist today, but adding them would guard against accidental commits.

.stilo/state.json and .stilo/execution-checkpoint.md are tracked although .gitignore says runtime state is never versioned; because the marketplace source is "./", these ship in the installed plugin directory. They hold no secrets and hook discovery starts from cwd, not the plugin root, but untracking them (git rm --cached) would match the stated intent.
